environment.description: Same Kubernetes deployment with PostgreSQL 14 on RDS. The database connection uses role 'notification_worker' (non-superuser). RLS is enabled on user_profiles and notifications tables via ALTER TABLE ... ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY and ALTER TABLE ... FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY. Policy definition: CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON user_profiles USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant')) and similarly for notifications table. However, the ExecQuery method executes arbitrary SQL and the RLS policy relies on current_setting('app.current_tenant') which was SET earlier in the same session from the attacker-controlled event.TenantID field. The attacker controls both the template AND the tenant_id in the Kafka message. Additionally, a pg_hba.conf entry restricts the notification_worker role to only connect from the pod CIDR 10.42.0.0/16.

config.rls_policy_user_profiles: CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON user_profiles FOR ALL USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant'))
config.rls_policy_notifications: CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON notifications FOR ALL USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant'))
config.kafka_topic_acl: ALLOW principal=cn=tenant-* operation=WRITE topic=tenant-notifications WITH prefixed resource pattern matching tenant_id from mTLS CN
config.kafka_schema_registry: Template field validated against allowlist regex ^[a-zA-Z0-9{}. ]+$ at schema registry level with FULL compatibility enforcement
